title: Sandstone NPCs
tagline: Mannequin-based NPCs with dialogue trees for Sandstone datapacks
description: Mannequin-based NPCs for [Sandstone](https://github.com/sandstone-mc/sandstone) datapacks: skinned, posable mannequins with typewriter-style dialogue trees. Fully self-contained, click detection uses a vanilla advancement trigger, no external dependencies required.
